notes: §1985:VI.6.18.2 prints four formats: TALLYING with repeated "identifier-2 <u>FOR</u>" items, each a repeated choice of CHARACTERS or ALL / LEADING with repeated operands; REPLACING with a repeated choice of CHARACTERS BY or ALL / LEADING / FIRST with repeated operand BY operand pairs; TALLYING followed by REPLACING; and CONVERTING operand TO operand; every operand and CHARACTERS phrase may carry BEFORE and AFTER INITIAL phrases (INITIAL optional), one of each (§1985:VI.6.18.3 SR4). The grammar rule inspectStatement takes exactly those four combinations in that order; inspectTallyingItem is one counter, one FOR and inspectCountPhrase repeated, inspectReplacingItem requires the adjective on the first pair, and the predicates IsBareInspectOperand and IsBareInspectReplacingPair end a bare-operand run at the next counter or adjective; inspectDelimiters is BEFORE and AFTER once each in either order. The grammar's wider adjective list is narrowed by InspectBinder.BindPhraseOperands at every edition (TRAILING, and FIRST in TALLYING: COBOL2269), and the one later-edition phrase, BACKWARD, is refused below COBOL-2023 by VersionConformancePass.VisitInspectStatement (COBOL0845), the edition arm 1985 reaches. The witness runs all four formats, with CHARACTERS, ALL, LEADING and FIRST and both delimiter phrases. Probed further at --std 85: three counters with mixed CHARACTERS, ALL and LEADING phrases, bare second operands, a comma, INITIAL omitted, BEFORE and AFTER in both orders, and format 3 with all four REPLACING adjectives compile and give the hand-derived counts and text; refused are BACKWARD, TRAILING, TALLYING FOR FIRST, a repeated BEFORE, REPLACING before TALLYING, TALLYING with CONVERTING, a second REPLACING or CONVERTING phrase, a second FOR, an operand with no adjective, a bare pair after CHARACTERS BY, a missing BY, TO or counter, and INSPECT with no phrase.

next.reason: 1985: "INSPECT identifier-1 TALLYING ... / INSPECT identifier-1 REPLACING ... / INSPECT identifier-1 CONVERTING ..."; 2023: "INSPECT [ BACKWARD ] identifier-1 TALLYING tallying-phrase (BACKWARD likewise in formats 2, 3, 4)". Same four formats and phrases. 2023 adds the optional BACKWARD phrase to all formats, so it accepts programs 1985 refuses. The AFTER/BEFORE repetition is only recast as choice indicators.
